institution: CUNY Graduate School and University Center

app_fee.value: The nonrefundable application fee is $75 USD.
app_fee.quote: Submit your online application along with the Graduate Center's nonrefundable $75 application fee and electronically sign the application.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are limited to U.S. Armed Services Veterans and McNair Scholars.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate Center cannot waive the application fee except for United States Armed Services Veterans and McNair Scholars.

gre_general.value: GRE General Test requirements vary by doctoral program; see each program record.

also.quote: Each program has different GRE requirements (although none set a minimum GRE score), so you should refer to the Deadlines and Requirements page to determine if you will be asked to submit scores for the GRE and/or Subject Test in the area of intended study.

toefl_min.value: No universal minimum TOEFL iBT score is set by the Graduate Center; individual programs review scores in the context of the full application.

also.quote: Individual programs at the Graduate Center may require a minimum score on the TOEFL iBT for admission to the program.
WHAT IS THE MINIMUM GRE/GMAT/TOEFL IBT/IELTS SCORE? | There are no minimum scores that guarantee admission.

ielts_min.value: No universal minimum IELTS score is set by the Graduate Center; individual programs review scores in the context of the full application.

also.quote: WHAT IS THE MINIMUM GRE/GMAT/TOEFL IBT/IELTS SCORE? | There are no minimum scores that guarantee admission.

english_waiver.value: Applicants who studied in India are not exempt from English language testing and must submit TOEFL iBT or IELTS scores.
english_waiver.quote: You must submit scores from either the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL iBT) or the International English Language Testing System (IELTS) unless you have a post-secondary degree from an institution in which the language of instruction is English-only and located in a country that recognizes English as an Official Language. | Applicants who have only studied in Puerto Rico or India must complete the TOEFL iBT or IELTS.

notes: The CUNY Graduate Center grants CUNY doctoral degrees in the natural sciences, mathematics, and computer science; engineering PhDs in the CUNY system are granted by the City College of New York Grove School of Engineering.
